name: Non-text Content
check_hint: Inventory images icons SVG canvas and generated graphics; an empty non-semantic span needs no aria-hidden by itself, and an empty-alt fallback is FAIL only for a proven informative instance.

name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
check_hint: Reuse the media inventory and inspect actual assets/content; controls, MIME type, or a registered player does not prove audio, synchronization, prerecorded status, or a rendered instance.

name: Captions (Prerecorded)
check_hint: Reuse the shared media inventory; prove a rendered or bounded source-controlled prerecorded synchronized-media instance before FAIL, then verify captions or a caption track and review accuracy manually.

name: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
check_hint: Find prerecorded video and verify audio description or a time-based media alternative; review adequacy manually.

name: Captions (Live)
check_hint: Find live synchronized media and caption-provider integration; verify live caption availability and accuracy at runtime.

name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
check_hint: Find prerecorded video and an audio-description track or version; review coverage and accuracy manually.

name: Info and Relationships
check_hint: Inspect headings landmarks lists tables groups labels and programmatic relationships; a skipped heading rank alone is a review signal not automatic FAIL without a misrepresented relationship.

name: Meaningful Sequence
check_hint: Inspect DOM or template order and CSS visual reordering; verify reading sequence in rendered output.

name: Sensory Characteristics
check_hint: Search instructions for shape color size visual location orientation or sound-only references and inspect alternatives.

name: Orientation
check_hint: Search orientation locks and fixed landscape or portrait assumptions; verify any essential exception manually.

name: Identify Input Purpose
check_hint: Trace production personal-data inputs and require valid autocomplete or equivalent purpose metadata; type=email is broad, autocomplete=off is not a purpose token, and merely removing autocomplete=off is not a sufficient remediation.

name: Use of Color
check_hint: Find states charts errors and instructions conveyed by color; inspect accompanying text icons patterns or semantics.

name: Audio Control
check_hint: Find automatically playing audio lasting over three seconds and inspect pause stop or independent volume controls.

name: Contrast (Minimum)
check_hint: Resolve source-defined color tokens and definite foreground/background pairs; require rendered checks only for unresolved cascade states imagery themes opacity and actual text size.

name: Resize Text
check_hint: Search fixed dimensions clipping and viewport restrictions that impede 200 percent text resize; verify rendered behavior.

name: Images of Text
check_hint: Find images or CSS assets containing text and determine whether the use is customizable or essential.

name: Reflow
check_hint: Find fixed widths min-width overflow and positioning risks; NEEDS_REVIEW with a 320 CSS pixel reflow check and relevant exceptions.

name: Non-text Contrast
check_hint: Resolve source-defined colors for UI boundaries focus states and graphics; verify only unresolved adjacent colors themes opacity and rendered states manually.

name: Text Spacing
check_hint: Find clipping fixed heights and overflow risks; NEEDS_REVIEW with WCAG text-spacing override checks in a browser.

name: Content on Hover or Focus
check_hint: Find tooltips popovers dropdowns submenus and all CSS or script hover/focus disclosures; verify dismissible hoverable and persistent behavior interactively.

name: Keyboard
check_hint: Inventory distinct functions, not handlers alone; a redundant pointer surface is not FAIL when the same native control/function remains keyboard operable and unobstructed.

name: No Keyboard Trap
check_hint: Identify focus traps overlays editors and custom widgets; NEEDS_REVIEW with keyboard entry and exit checks for in-scope focusable UI.

name: Character Key Shortcuts
check_hint: Find single-character keyboard shortcuts and verify off remap or active-focus-only controls.

name: Timing Adjustable
check_hint: Find session timeouts countdowns and expiring interactions; inspect extend disable or exception handling.

name: Pause, Stop, Hide
check_hint: Find auto-updating moving blinking scrolling or rotating content and inspect user controls and exceptions.

name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
check_hint: Find flashing animation and all actual or externally selected media; unavailable CMS or hosted video remains NEEDS_REVIEW rather than N/A.

name: Bypass Blocks
check_hint: Inspect repeated navigation layouts for skip links landmarks or equivalent bypass mechanisms across page templates.

name: Page Titled
check_hint: Inventory route and document-title generation and verify every in-scope page receives a descriptive title.

name: Focus Order
check_hint: Inspect tabindex DOM order portals and focus management; NEEDS_REVIEW with interactive sequence checks for relevant states.

name: Link Purpose (In Context)
check_hint: Inventory links and accessible names; judge purpose with programmatically determined context and generated content.

name: Multiple Ways
check_hint: Inventory page-discovery mechanisms such as navigation search sitemap and related links; verify page-set coverage.

name: Headings and Labels
check_hint: Inspect headings and control labels for topic or purpose and flag ambiguous generated copy for content review.

name: Focus Visible
check_hint: Locate focus-style implementations and suppression risks; NEEDS_REVIEW with focused-state visibility checks; distinguish 2.4.11 obstruction and 2.4.13 AAA area.

name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
check_hint: Find sticky fixed and overlay content; verify focused controls are not entirely hidden in relevant viewports and states.

name: Pointer Gestures
check_hint: Find multipoint or path-based gestures and inspect single-pointer alternatives and essential exceptions.

name: Pointer Cancellation
check_hint: Inventory all single-pointer functions including native controls and click handlers; native/click up-event activation is positive evidence, then inspect down-event handlers for cancellation abort undo or essential behavior.

name: Label in Name
check_hint: Compare visible control text with programmatic accessible names including generated labels and icon controls.

name: Motion Actuation
check_hint: Find device or user-motion listeners and inspect conventional input alternatives and disable controls.

name: Dragging Movements
check_hint: Find drag-and-drop interactions and verify a non-dragging single-pointer alternative unless dragging is essential.

name: Target Size (Minimum)
check_hint: Undersized controls require NEEDS_REVIEW: check actual targets, 24px-diameter spacing circles, and all exceptions; a gap below 24px alone is not failure.

name: Language of Page
check_hint: Inspect root lang generation for every page or locale and verify values match actual rendered language.

name: Language of Parts
check_hint: Find passages in other human languages and inspect scoped lang attributes or equivalent semantics.

name: On Focus
check_hint: Treat every focusable UI component as applicable; inspect focus handlers for automatic navigation submission or context changes and use exhaustive absence as PASS evidence rather than N/A.

name: On Input
check_hint: Treat fields selects checkboxes and stateful controls as applicable; inspect change/input handlers for unexpected context changes and use exhaustive absence as PASS evidence rather than N/A.

name: Consistent Navigation
check_hint: Compare repeated navigation components and ordering across page templates and responsive variants.

name: Consistent Identification
check_hint: Compare components with the same function for consistent names icons labels and semantics.

name: Consistent Help
check_hint: Find human contact details/mechanisms, self-help, or automated contact mechanisms and compare order; newsletters and generic footer content are not help by themselves.

name: Error Identification
check_hint: Inspect validation paths for textual error identification linked to the affected item; verify announcements and states.

name: Labels or Instructions
check_hint: Inventory user-input controls; accept explicit and wrapping-label association, and do not require aria-label fallback merely because a native input is visually styled or visually hidden.

name: Error Suggestion
check_hint: Inspect validation errors for actionable correction suggestions when known and not security-sensitive.

name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
check_hint: Find consequential submissions and inspect reversible review-and-confirm or error-checking mechanisms.

name: Redundant Entry
check_hint: Trace multi-step processes for repeated data entry and inspect auto-population selection or essential exceptions.

name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
check_hint: Inspect authentication for cognitive-function tests and verify alternatives assistance or object-recognition exceptions.

name: Name, Role, Value
check_hint: Inventory UI components and trace native semantics plus ARIA states; native checkboxes expose checked state without aria-checked on non-semantic visual wrappers, while authored widget roles must have required owned roles/states.

name: Status Messages
check_hint: Find dynamic status and result messages; trace the mutation target and live-region semantics in the same reachable template branch and runtime path, then verify announcement without forced focus.
